title: Kuldra Raid Boss in RuneScape Dragonwilds (Ranged Main)
author: Wings of Absurdity
description:
The final boss of the Kuldra Saga, Kuldra herself. This wraps up the Scorned Wilderness Raid with her being the final boss.

 #runescape #rsdragonwilds #dragonwilds #survivalgames

comments.author: @xLynxsy
comments.text: Once u get the d scim, whetstone + air weapon enchant clears the dragons so fast. i just use the dorg cbow for the final heart phase. also steak sandwich is the best food here for shock and poison effect

comments.author: @WingsofAbsurdity
comments.text: I've played the game primarily using ranged, don't got preference for melee weapons but the whole raid felt like a letdown tbh. Was hoping for more mob variety.

comments.text: @WingsofAbsurdity  Makes sense, just for time efficiency i was saying the d scim is much better, I did the fight caves in full ranged and i regret it cus it took me an hour+ lol. and yes i agree 100% severely underwhelming update.

comments.author: @IamFrankEU
comments.text:
Thanks for this video, it’s really helpful. Maybe you can help me with one other thing. 

I tried kuldra many times and stuck on dying from the same mechanic: the Hyper beam attack. When I look at your video you got hit by it some times, but it’s only dealing around 100 damage. I got one-shotted many times. Any ideas why that is? I wear power level 7 armor. Thanks again!

comments.author: @WingsofAbsurdity
comments.text: I found standing on the starting position of the beam can double hit you which insta kills you.

comments.author: @Me_Sean
comments.text: Man, I was kinda sad, after just finishing valheim, going into the scorched wilderness was kinda a let down. instead of fighting a boss, It felt like I was just dodging environmental hazards and dealing with constant fodder spawns. Annoyingly enough both games made their final encounters resistant to ranged/piercing dmg... >:(

comments.author: @WingsofAbsurdity
comments.text: I felt it was cool at first but to be met with an uninteresting final phase... yeah. Imaru despite being super difficult was the best and most unique.

comments.author: @Me_Sean
comments.text: @WingsofAbsurdity  Agree with the imaru take. honestly, I enjoyed all the prior dragonwilds bosses, with my least favorite being Fuzan(the fight itself is great, it's just being forced to do a fight caves style minigame every refight felt bad). That the final fight doesn't even have us directly fighting the boss just makes me sad. :(

comments.text: @Me_Sean  tbf you cant really fight kuldra like you do other dragons, she is on par with gods and is too massive. youd have to go full kratos and that just wouldnt be runescape.
